examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-text-to-speech lang="en-GB" show-text="">
  <script type="tp/txt">
    Welcome to tp-components. This example uses the browser speech synthesis service.
  </script>
</tp-text-to-speech>

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Starts reading after the source is loaded when browser policy permits it.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of an element supplying readable text; overrides local sources and synchronizes word boundaries when the target is tp-typewriting.

attributes.name: legend
attributes.description: Caption of the fieldset surrounding the controls.

attributes.name: lite
attributes.description: Replaces playback controls with a single speak/stop icon button.

attributes.name: pause-after-colon
attributes.description: Additional silence in milliseconds after colons at a word boundary; zero preserves browser prosody without adding a timer.

attributes.name: pause-after-comma
attributes.description: Additional silence in milliseconds after commas at a word boundary; zero preserves browser prosody without adding a timer.

attributes.name: pause-after-semicolon
attributes.description: Additional silence in milliseconds after semicolons at a word boundary; zero preserves browser prosody without adding a timer.

attributes.name: pause-after-sentence
attributes.description: Additional silence in milliseconds after sentence punctuation (. ! ? and ellipses) at a word boundary; zero preserves browser prosody without adding a timer.

attributes.name: pause-between-lines
attributes.description: Silence in milliseconds between nonempty lines; an explicit [pause=...] overrides it at a line boundary.

attributes.name: pause-per-blank-line
attributes.description: Additional milliseconds for each blank or whitespace-only line between spoken passages; consecutive blank lines accumulate.

attributes.name: show-text
attributes.description: Displays the source text alongside the playback controls.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Text file loaded relative to the containing document.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Text supplied directly as an attribute.

attributes.name: voice
attributes.description: Preferred installed voice name or language tag.

methods.name: pause(): void
methods.description: Pauses speech or a scheduled silence.

methods.name: resume(): void
methods.description: Resumes speech or the remainder of a scheduled silence.

methods.name: speak(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Uses the browser's voice for the language unless a voice is explicitly requested.

methods.name: stop(): void
methods.description: Cancels speech, queued segments and scheduled silence.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-end
events.description: Emitted when the complete reading finishes.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-error
events.description: Emitted when loading or speech synthesis fails.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-pause
events.description: Emitted when active playback is paused.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-ready
events.description: Emitted when the current source is loaded and the controls are ready.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-stop
events.description: Emitted when active playback is cancelled, including source changes.

events.name: tp-text-to-speech-trigger
events.description: Emitted when a named trigger command is reached during playback; commands are never spoken or shown.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-text-to-speech>` element reads text aloud.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Speak | Start reading the text aloud. |
| Pause | Suspend speech or freeze the remaining scheduled silence. |
| Resume | Continue paused speech or the remaining silence. |
| Stop | End reading and cancel pending segments or pauses. |
| Settings | Choose a voice for the text language; scroll the voice list when it exceeds the available space; Automatic lets the browser choose. Changing the voice stops reading. |
| Compact speaker / stop button | Start or stop reading. Pause, Resume and voice settings are not available in this presentation. |
| Status | Indicates whether speech is ready, playing, paused or unavailable. Voice availability depends on the browser and operating system. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Activates the native button inside each tp-button control.
